author: reek
body: The call construct on the ARM64 LIR selector (LirRetarget step 4f), pinned by answers that change when the argument order changes.

author: reek
body: Every helper here carries an `if` so that `inline-leaf-calls` will not eat it: that pass takes a body of pure integer arithmetic over the callee's own parameters and nothing else, so `hdiff a b = a - b` would vanish into its callers and this file would test nothing. Each helper also has at least two callers, because `inline-single-caller` takes the ones that have exactly one. Both facts were read off `IR/Lowering.codex` rather than guessed; a test whose subject is optimised away still passes.

author: reek
body: `hdiff` is `a - b` written so it cannot be inlined, and it is asymmetric on purpose: a symmetric helper answers the same thing whichever way its arguments are placed, so `callswap` would agree with `callplain` however wrong the placement was. The same reasoning picks `htri`, whose three arguments land in different decimal places.
